answers.question: What is the TradeHQ AI Mentor?
answers.renderedAnswer: An educational mentor using a labelled built-in library of authored answers and topic matching. It makes no AI API request. It explains trading concepts; it does not assess whether a real-money trade suits you.

answers.question: Can the AI Mentor predict prices?
answers.renderedAnswer: No. This chat matches questions to a built-in educational answer library. It does not read your journal or trade history, forecast prices or assess whether an investment suits you.

answers.question: Is the AI Mentor free?
answers.renderedAnswer: Yes — it is included free with every TradeHQ account, no signup or payment required.

answers.question: What questions should I ask?
answers.renderedAnswer: Try things like: 'Explain stop-loss orders', 'What is dollar-cost averaging?', 'How do I manage risk on a $100K portfolio?', or 'Walk me through a candlestick pattern'.

limitation: Actual safe FAQ expansion only; no account, order, form or quiz submission. Answer collection does not establish substantive review.
